VG-Bench
	

VG-Bench (Visually-Grounded Benchmark) is a curated set of 912 multiple-choice video questions that are verified to require watching the video to answer correctly.

	
		
		Source Benchmarks
	

All questions are drawn from three established video understanding benchmarks:
